children: UK colour cosmetics supplier's H1 revenue fell 17.8% amid challenging trading conditions
Adjusted EPS for H1 dropped 46.6%, with adjusted EBITDA down 36.4% yr/yr
Company expects 2026 revenue towards the lower end of £103.3 mln to £112.6 mln range
Company expects 2026 Adjusted EBITDA within £22.4 mln to £24.0 mln analyst forecast range
Company says 2026 performance expected to be more second-half weighted due to order timing and Christmas gifting
MACROECONOMIC HEADWINDS - Co cited pressure on consumer spending and cautious retailer ordering in UK and EU as main reasons for revenue decline
CUSTOMER LOSS - Loss of Bodycare, a major Technic customer, after it entered administration in 2025 contributed to lower sales
GROSS MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Gross margin rose due to sourcing strategy, new product development, and one-off benefit from selling Barry M inventory acquired at a discount
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the personal products peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Warpaint London PLC is GBp340.00, about 51.8% above its September 22 closing price of GBp224.00
The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
